international.title: Cap all political donations, not only those from overseas, Burnham told
international.summary: Experts say ‘insanely complex’ £100,000 limit proposed for overseas donors should be replaced by universal cap Andy Burnham is facing calls to commit to a cap on all political donations when the elections bill is in the House of Lords, instead of the “insanely complex” £100,000 limit on overseas donors. It is uncertain whether the £72m worth of donations recently received by Reform UK will be affected. The Labour former home secretary David Blunkett is one of many peers to have tabled an amendment calling for an overall cap, proposing a £500,000 annual limit per donor, with his plan believed to have broad support.
